name: Nedrefosshytta - Sieimmastua / Sieimma
waterSources: Remote mountain section; carry capacity and treat natural water unless a hut/service page confirms potable water.

facilities.name: Sieimmastua
facilities.description: Reservable west-bank log cabin at the edge of Reisa National Park. Reisa describes simple self-catering use, 2-4 beds, wood stove, gas stove, outdoor toilet, stream/Reisaelva water, no power and no mobile coverage.
facilities.routeProximity: selected start endpoint; about 21 m from route-line projection

facilities.name: Sieimmahytta / Sieimahytta
facilities.description: Open Statskog cabin on the east side of Reisaelva, across from the Nordkalott Trail. Reisa says 4-6 people; Statskog says 4 beds and simple standard with outdoor toilet, wood stove, wood, gas stove, kitchen/dining equipment and no prebooking.
facilities.routeProximity: about 55-90 m from route-side projection, across Reisaelva by rowboat

facilities.name: Mollis rest shelter / gapahuk
facilities.description: Rustic shelter/gapahuk at the Mollis/Mollisfossen rest area. Reisa official/currentness sources confirm a rest area, fire, tables/benches, toilet and gapahuk at Mollis.
facilities.routeProximity: about 65-70 m from the OSM/E1 route line; possibly riverbank/riverboat rest cluster

facilities.name: Mollisfossen / Mollešgorži / Molliskurkkii
facilities.description: Major waterfall on the eastern side of Reisaelva, visible from or near the Nordkalott Trail corridor and a common riverboat destination.
facilities.routeProximity: about 0.5 km from nearest route point and across/near the river corridor

facilities.name: Vuomatakka / Vuomadakka / Vuomatakkagammen
facilities.description: Open Statskog timber hut/gamme in Reisa National Park, free use, 2 beds, wood heat/cooking, no lighting and outdoor toilet. Reisa/Statskog place it about 20 km above Saraelv and about 6 km from Nedrefosshytta in the official Nedrefoss-Saraelv narrative.
facilities.routeProximity: OSM/E1/Statskog-map coordinate is on or near the route; Kartverket coordinate is about 150-185 m from route and about 540 m from OSM/E1

facilities.name: Nedrefosshytta
facilities.description: DNT/Troms Turlag cabin at the section endpoint. UT describes 16 beds, open year-round, locked with special key/code/booking requirements, wood stove, gas cooking, kitchen equipment, sauna/safety annex, outhouse, dog room and no mobile coverage.
facilities.routeProximity: selected end endpoint; about 8 m from route endpoint
